claims.claim_text: The indexed Steve F Norsic Jr. is a high-confidence match to the reviewed official Army record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Exact indexed name, suffix, and a nonshared protected identifier agree with official Army bulk ordinal 6018184.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact name, suffix, and nonshared protected-identifier agreement in official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes identity but not a pre-OSS employer or assignment.
claims.match_notes: Coded Army occupation data are not converted into employer evidence.

claims.claim_text: The indexed David T Northault has a protected-identifier match to an Army record spelling the surname Northcutt.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier and given names agree, but the official sources disagree on the surname.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: the identifier is strong evidence, but the Northault/Northcutt discrepancy requires personnel-file review.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict concerns identity only and yields no reliable pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: The index itself labels the row possibly; neither spelling is silently corrected.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Capt. Robert P Northup is a high-confidence match to the Round Lake Cornell graduate who served as an Army Air Forces captain.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Cornell and a contemporary newspaper agree on the exact name and Round Lake; the newspaper also identifies him as an Army Air Forces captain.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact name plus matching home locality, wartime captain rank, branch, and 1941 engineering education across independent sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish identity and education but do not date OSS accession.
claims.match_notes: No service identifier is exposed or inferred; the conclusion rests on multiple corroborating identifiers beyond the name.

claims.claim_text: Robert P. Northup received a Mechanical Engineering degree from Cornell University in June 1941.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Cornell's commencement report names Robert P. Northup of Round Lake among Mechanical Engineering degree recipients.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity based on exact name, locality, military rank, and branch corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar education; neither employment nor immediate succession to OSS is claimed.
claims.match_notes: Cornell is classified as a student affiliation, never an employer.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Rudolf S Nothmann has a protected-identifier match to an Army record spelling the surname Nothman.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier and given name agree, but the official sources disagree on spelling and the Army name field is unusually formatted.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: likely related records, but the Nothmann/Nothman discrepancy requires personnel-file review.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Theodore Notides is a high-confidence match to the reviewed official Army record and the New York banker documented by contemporary sources.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact uncommon name and protected identifier match official Army evidence; independent banking and Library of Congress sources agree on employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact uncommon name, nonshared protected identifier, dated Army entry, and independent institutional corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: Army entry on 26 August 1942 bounds the preceding civilian employment, but no reviewed source dates OSS accession.
claims.match_notes: The Army civilian-occupation code is not used as evidence; the employment claim rests on named sources.

claims.claim_text: Theodore Notides's last currently identified civilian employer before Army entry was Manufacturers Trust Company, which he joined in 1941.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary banking journal gives the 1941 start, and an official Army record dates entry to 26 August 1942.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact uncommon name, official identifier agreement, and independent employer corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded last civilian employment; immediate succession to OSS is not claimed.
claims.match_notes: The Library of Congress finding aid independently pairs Theodore Notides with Manufacturers Trust Company.
